inputs.text: Seamless repeatable hand-painted videogame material. EXACTLY perpendicular flat full-frame macro albedo material scan, no perspective, no object silhouette. The entire square is one continuous surface, every edge and corner has the same density, scale and brightness. Painterly gouache brushwork with beautiful broad and medium shapes and sparse fine details. Unlit intrinsic colors, soft restrained contrast. No scenery, no landscape, no background, no border, no frame, no vignette, no cast shadows, no central highlight, no text. A flat continuous cropped tree bark material, flowing vertical grain of warm chestnut and ochre. Medium long organic ridges with subtle muted plum recesses, delicate pale edges and very sparse sage moss in cracks. No trunk outline, no branches, no forest, no large central knot, no strong perspective.
